subject: Designing Versioned Capability Leases for a Shared Android DSP
title_ko: 공유 Android DSP를 위한 Versioned Capability Lease 설계
summary_ko: 가상의 Android 시스템 SW 설계 회의에서 client 종료 뒤에도 DSP logical reservation이 남아 camera·audio·transcription workload가 CPU로 밀리는 문제를 논의한다. 팀들은 generation-tagged command, positive renewal, two-stage expiry, class별 admission budget과 isolated context reset을 결합한 제한적 pilot을 결정한다. 모든 인물·조직·단말·DSP·firmware·workload·로그·결함·수치·일정은 Business English 교육을 위한 가상 설정이며 실제 기업이나 제품의 실제 결함을 주장하지 않는다.

turns.speaker: Samir Gupta
turns.en: Android Media Framework, DSP and Kernel, Performance Quality, and Platform Architecture are represented. We are reviewing how camera enhancement, spatial audio, and on-device transcription share the new vector DSP. Field simulation found that a client process can die after receiving hardware capacity but before releasing its framework session. The kernel eventually reclaims memory, yet the scheduler keeps the logical reservation for up to eighteen minutes. Other clients then fall back to CPU processing, increasing latency, power, and heat. Today we need a cross-layer ownership model, evidence for safe reclamation, fairness rules, measurable gates, exact owners, and a follow-up time. Please challenge any proposal that relies on one process reporting its own health after that process may already be gone.
turns.ko: Android Media Framework, DSP·Kernel, Performance Quality, Platform Architecture 팀이 참석했습니다. Camera enhancement, spatial audio, on-device transcription이 새 vector DSP를 공유하는 방식을 검토합니다. Field simulation에서는 client process가 hardware capacity를 받은 뒤 framework session을 해제하기 전에 종료될 수 있었습니다. Kernel은 결국 memory를 회수하지만 scheduler는 logical reservation을 최대 18분 유지합니다. 다른 client는 CPU 처리로 fallback해 latency·power·heat가 증가합니다. 오늘은 cross-layer ownership model, 안전한 reclamation 증거, fairness rule, 측정 gate, 담당자와 후속 회의를 정합니다. 이미 사라졌을 수 있는 process가 스스로 health를 보고하는 데 의존하는 제안은 검토해 주세요.

turns.speaker: Chloe Martin
turns.en: Quality reproduced 46 stranded reservations in 9,600 mixed-workload cycles. The trigger was not limited to a crash. We saw it after low-memory killing, user switching, camera permission revocation, and one forced media-service restart. In 31 cases, spatial audio missed its twenty-millisecond deadline for more than four seconds. In nine cases, transcription moved to the CPU and raised package power by 2.3 watts. The DSP firmware did not hang, and its command queue was empty; the unavailable capacity existed only in the broker's bookkeeping. Reboot cleared every case, while restarting the original client did not. That evidence points to a stale ownership contract rather than resource exhaustion or firmware failure.
turns.ko: Quality는 mixed workload 9,600회 중 stranded reservation 46건을 재현했습니다. Trigger는 crash에만 국한되지 않았고 low-memory killing, user switching, camera permission revocation, media-service 강제 restart 뒤에도 발생했습니다. 31건에서 spatial audio가 20ms deadline을 4초 넘게 놓쳤습니다. 9건에서는 transcription이 CPU로 이동해 package power가 2.3W 증가했습니다. DSP firmware는 hang하지 않았고 command queue도 비어 있었으며 unavailable capacity는 broker bookkeeping에만 존재했습니다. Reboot는 모든 case를 없앴지만 original client restart는 그렇지 않았습니다. 증거는 resource exhaustion이나 firmware failure가 아니라 stale ownership contract를 가리킵니다.

turns.speaker: Arjun Patel
turns.en: The kernel driver knows which file descriptor submitted each command, but it does not know which framework feature owns the reservation. One framework session may open several command channels, and a service restart can inherit a surviving proxy. If the driver reclaims capacity on the first descriptor close, it may interrupt valid work on another channel. If it waits for every descriptor, a leaked proxy can preserve capacity indefinitely. The firmware currently exposes queue activity and physical context identifiers, not business-level session identity. I do not want to put camera, audio, or transcription policy into the driver. We need a narrow primitive that proves liveness without teaching the kernel about product features.
turns.ko: Kernel driver는 각 command를 제출한 file descriptor를 알지만 어떤 framework feature가 reservation을 소유하는지는 모릅니다. Framework session 하나가 여러 command channel을 열 수 있고 service restart가 surviving proxy를 상속할 수 있습니다. 첫 descriptor close 때 capacity를 회수하면 다른 channel의 유효 작업을 끊을 수 있습니다. 모든 descriptor를 기다리면 leaked proxy가 capacity를 무기한 보존할 수 있습니다. Firmware는 queue activity와 physical context identifier를 노출하지만 business-level session identity는 모릅니다. Driver에 camera·audio·transcription 정책을 넣고 싶지 않습니다. Kernel이 product feature를 알지 않고도 liveness를 증명하는 좁은 primitive가 필요합니다.

turns.speaker: Hana Lee
turns.en: Framework created the ambiguity by treating reservation, session, and process lifetime as the same thing. They are not. A session can survive a client reconnect, a reservation can outlive one command channel, and process death can occur before our cleanup callback. I propose a versioned capability lease. The broker issues a lease with a unique generation, owner token, capacity class, maximum idle interval, and renewal deadline. Every command carries the lease generation. The kernel accepts work only for the current generation and reports the last completed command. Renewal requires both a live framework owner and observed DSP progress. When either side disagrees, the broker stops renewal and the kernel reclaims capacity at a bounded deadline.
turns.ko: Framework가 reservation, session, process lifetime을 같은 것으로 취급해 ambiguity를 만들었습니다. 실제로는 다릅니다. Session은 client reconnect 뒤에도 살아남을 수 있고 reservation은 command channel 하나보다 오래 지속될 수 있으며 process death가 cleanup callback보다 먼저 일어날 수 있습니다. Versioned capability lease를 제안합니다. Broker는 unique generation, owner token, capacity class, maximum idle interval, renewal deadline이 있는 lease를 발급합니다. 모든 command는 lease generation을 포함합니다. Kernel은 current generation의 work만 받고 마지막 completed command를 보고합니다. Renewal에는 live framework owner와 관찰된 DSP progress가 모두 필요합니다. 한쪽이라도 불일치하면 broker는 renewal을 멈추고 kernel은 제한된 deadline에 capacity를 회수합니다.

turns.speaker: Victor Ramos
turns.en: I reconstructed the lifecycle from binder traces, driver events, and firmware counters. The problematic sequence has three independent clocks: client death at time A, broker awareness at time B, and descriptor cleanup at time C. B may be delayed when the media service is overloaded, and C may never happen if a proxy remains referenced. Firmware progress stops near A, so it is the earliest neutral signal, but zero progress can also mean a valid paused camera preview. A timer alone cannot decide ownership. We need positive renewal from the framework plus a kernel-observed progress watermark. The absence of either should expire capacity, but the timeout must differ by workload class and be bounded by a platform maximum.
turns.ko: Binder trace, driver event, firmware counter로 lifecycle을 재구성했습니다. 문제 sequence에는 client death A, broker awareness B, descriptor cleanup C라는 독립 clock 세 개가 있습니다. Media service overload 시 B가 지연될 수 있고 proxy reference가 남으면 C는 오지 않을 수 있습니다. Firmware progress는 A 근처에서 멈춰 가장 빠른 neutral signal이지만 zero progress는 유효하게 pause된 camera preview일 수도 있습니다. Timer만으로 ownership을 판단할 수 없습니다. Framework의 positive renewal과 kernel-observed progress watermark가 함께 필요합니다. 둘 중 하나라도 없으면 capacity를 만료시키되 timeout은 workload class별로 다르고 platform maximum으로 제한해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Novak
turns.en: I support generations, but renewal must not become a high-frequency control loop. Waking the application processor every second would erase the DSP's power advantage. The driver can maintain a low-cost hardware heartbeat from completion interrupts and expose a watermark when the broker is already awake. For paused workloads, the framework can request a dormant lease with less capacity and a longer deadline. A dormant lease cannot submit high-bandwidth commands without promotion, and promotion receives a new generation. Active leases should expire after six seconds without renewal; dormant leases after forty-five seconds, with an absolute platform cap of sixty. These values are starting points for measurement, not promises to any application.
turns.ko: Generation을 지지하지만 renewal이 high-frequency control loop가 되면 안 됩니다. Application processor를 매초 깨우면 DSP power 이점이 사라집니다. Driver는 completion interrupt로 low-cost hardware heartbeat를 유지하고 broker가 이미 깨어 있을 때 watermark를 노출할 수 있습니다. Paused workload는 더 적은 capacity와 긴 deadline의 dormant lease를 요청할 수 있습니다. Dormant lease는 promotion 없이 high-bandwidth command를 제출할 수 없고 promotion은 새 generation을 받습니다. Active lease는 renewal 없이 6초, dormant lease는 45초 뒤 만료하며 absolute platform cap은 60초로 제안합니다. 이 값은 측정 출발점이지 application에 대한 약속이 아닙니다.

turns.speaker: Chloe Martin
turns.en: The timeout proposal creates a user-visible tradeoff. Six seconds limits stranded capacity, but an overloaded framework may miss renewal while valid audio is still playing. We injected two-second main-thread stalls and saw renewal jitter reach 4.8 seconds. A single late renewal would cause an audible mode change if the DSP context is revoked. I want a two-stage expiry: first mark the lease suspect and reject new capacity growth, then reclaim only after a second independent check. The second check could be binder owner liveness or a fresh command completion. This gives a valid session one chance to prove itself without allowing the stale reservation to grow. We should measure false reclamation separately from slow reclamation.
turns.ko: 6초 timeout은 stranded capacity를 제한하지만 overloaded framework가 valid audio 재생 중 renewal을 놓칠 수 있어 user-visible tradeoff가 생깁니다. Main-thread stall 2초를 주입했을 때 renewal jitter가 4.8초까지 갔습니다. Late renewal 한 번으로 DSP context가 revoke되면 audible mode change가 생깁니다. Two-stage expiry를 원합니다. 먼저 lease를 suspect로 표시하고 새 capacity growth를 거부한 뒤 두 번째 독립 check 후에만 reclaim합니다. 두 번째 check는 binder owner liveness나 fresh command completion이 될 수 있습니다. Stale reservation이 커지는 것은 막으면서 valid session이 자신을 증명할 기회 한 번을 줍니다. False reclamation과 slow reclamation을 별도 측정해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Samir Gupta
turns.en: That is the central disagreement: whether bounded recovery should optimize for fast reclamation or continuity. We can avoid choosing one global answer by defining invariants and class budgets. No lease may grow after it becomes suspect. No command from an older generation may execute after promotion or reassignment. Every active lease must have two independent liveness signals within its class budget. Every reclaim must produce a reason code visible to Quality. Within those boundaries, audio may receive a short grace interval, while burst camera processing can be reclaimed immediately after owner death because its next frame can rebuild state. The architecture should encode safety invariants centrally and let class policy choose latency.
turns.ko: 핵심 이견은 bounded recovery가 빠른 reclamation과 continuity 중 무엇을 최적화해야 하는지입니다. Global answer 하나 대신 invariant와 class budget을 정의할 수 있습니다. Suspect가 된 lease는 grow할 수 없습니다. Promotion이나 reassignment 뒤 older generation command는 실행되면 안 됩니다. 모든 active lease는 class budget 안에서 독립 liveness signal 두 개를 가져야 합니다. 모든 reclaim은 Quality가 볼 수 있는 reason code를 만들어야 합니다. 이 경계 안에서 audio는 짧은 grace interval을 받고 burst camera processing은 다음 frame에서 state를 재구축할 수 있으므로 owner death 직후 회수할 수 있습니다. Architecture는 safety invariant를 중앙에 두고 class policy가 latency를 선택하게 해야 합니다.

sections.title_en: Design Options and Cross Team Disagreement

turns.speaker: Arjun Patel
turns.en: Option one is binder-death cleanup only. It is simple but fails when a framework proxy survives. Option two is periodic framework renewal without kernel generations. It detects stale owners but cannot prevent an old command arriving after capacity is reassigned. Option three combines generation-tagged commands, positive renewal, hardware progress, and two-stage expiry. I recommend option three despite its larger scope because it closes both leakage and stale-command hazards. The driver will keep a compact lease table with generation, capacity, state, progress watermark, and deadline. It will not store package names or user identifiers. The broker maps product features to capacity classes outside the kernel.
turns.ko: Option 1은 binder-death cleanup만 사용해 단순하지만 framework proxy가 살아남으면 실패합니다. Option 2는 kernel generation 없이 periodic framework renewal을 사용해 stale owner는 감지하지만 capacity 재할당 뒤 old command 도착을 막지 못합니다. Option 3은 generation-tagged command, positive renewal, hardware progress, two-stage expiry를 결합합니다. Scope가 크지만 leakage와 stale-command hazard를 모두 막으므로 option 3을 권합니다. Driver는 generation, capacity, state, progress watermark, deadline의 compact lease table을 유지합니다. Package name이나 user identifier는 저장하지 않습니다. Broker는 kernel 밖에서 product feature를 capacity class에 mapping합니다.

turns.speaker: Hana Lee
turns.en: Framework can implement option three, but I disagree with letting each feature invent its own timeout. That would create hidden priority and make field analysis impossible. We should define three platform classes: interactive continuous, interactive burst, and deferred background. Each class has a maximum active deadline, suspect grace, dormant capacity ceiling, and fallback contract. Features select a class through a reviewed manifest, not runtime preference. When a lease expires, the framework receives an explicit terminal result and must create a new session generation before retrying. It cannot silently reuse buffers from the old lease. This makes recovery observable and prevents a retry from impersonating continuity.
turns.ko: Framework는 option 3을 구현할 수 있지만 feature마다 timeout을 만들게 하는 데 반대합니다. 숨은 priority를 만들고 field analysis를 어렵게 합니다. Interactive continuous, interactive burst, deferred background의 platform class 세 개를 정의해야 합니다. 각 class는 maximum active deadline, suspect grace, dormant capacity ceiling, fallback contract를 가집니다. Feature는 runtime preference가 아니라 review된 manifest로 class를 선택합니다. Lease가 만료되면 framework는 명시적 terminal result를 받고 retry 전 새 session generation을 만들어야 합니다. Old lease buffer를 조용히 재사용할 수 없습니다. 이렇게 하면 recovery가 관측 가능하고 retry가 continuity를 가장하지 못합니다.

turns.speaker: Victor Ramos
turns.en: We also need backpressure before the system reaches exhaustion. Today the broker grants reservations in request order and discovers scarcity only when the DSP rejects allocation. I propose class-level admission budgets and a queue with aging. Interactive continuous work gets a protected minimum, but unused protected capacity returns to the shared pool after two seconds. Burst work may borrow capacity with a revocable flag. Background work receives no hard reservation and checkpoints between command groups. Aging prevents a stream of camera bursts from starving transcription forever. The broker should publish grant delay, borrowed capacity, preemption count, and CPU fallback duration. Fairness must be measurable rather than inferred from average utilization.
turns.ko: System이 exhaustion에 도달하기 전 backpressure도 필요합니다. 현재 broker는 request order로 reservation을 주고 DSP allocation 거부 때 scarcity를 발견합니다. Class-level admission budget과 aging queue를 제안합니다. Interactive continuous work는 protected minimum을 받지만 사용하지 않은 protected capacity는 2초 뒤 shared pool로 돌아갑니다. Burst work는 revocable flag와 함께 capacity를 borrow할 수 있습니다. Background work는 hard reservation 없이 command group 사이 checkpoint를 합니다. Aging은 camera burst stream이 transcription을 영구 starve하지 못하게 합니다. Broker는 grant delay, borrowed capacity, preemption count, CPU fallback duration을 게시해야 합니다. Fairness는 average utilization에서 추론하지 말고 측정 가능해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Novak
turns.en: Borrowing is acceptable if revocation is cooperative first and forced second. The driver sends a revoke notice with a class-specific deadline. The framework stops submitting, drains completed output, and acknowledges. If it misses the deadline, the driver increments the generation, rejects old commands, resets only that context, and records forced reclaim. A full DSP reset is reserved for firmware nonresponse, not ordinary lease expiry. We should never punish unrelated sessions for one stale owner. The context reset path currently takes twelve milliseconds, but firmware validation covers only two simultaneous contexts. I own extending it to eight contexts and proving that neighboring command streams keep their sequence numbers and output checksums.
turns.ko: Borrowing은 revocation이 먼저 cooperative하고 그다음 forced라면 수용할 수 있습니다. Driver는 class-specific deadline과 revoke notice를 보냅니다. Framework는 submit을 멈추고 completed output을 drain한 뒤 acknowledge합니다. Deadline을 놓치면 driver는 generation을 증가시키고 old command를 거부하며 해당 context만 reset하고 forced reclaim을 기록합니다. Full DSP reset은 일반 lease expiry가 아니라 firmware nonresponse에만 씁니다. Stale owner 하나 때문에 unrelated session을 처벌하면 안 됩니다. Context reset은 현재 12ms지만 firmware validation은 simultaneous context 2개만 다룹니다. 저는 8개 context로 확대하고 neighboring command stream의 sequence number와 output checksum이 유지됨을 증명합니다.

turns.speaker: Samir Gupta
turns.en: The decision is option three with three reviewed platform classes, two-stage expiry, generation-tagged commands, and class-level admission budgets. Hana owns framework lease creation, terminal results, and new-generation retry by November 13 at 18:00 KST. Victor owns the admission queue, aging, and metrics by November 14 at noon. Arjun owns the driver lease table, generation rejection, and suspect transition by November 14 at 17:00. Elena owns isolated context reset and eight-context firmware validation by November 15 at noon. Chloe owns fault injection and acceptance reporting. I own the manifest review process, class definitions, and architecture record. No feature may bypass the broker or request a private timeout.
turns.ko: 결정은 review된 platform class 세 개, two-stage expiry, generation-tagged command, class-level admission budget을 포함한 option 3입니다. Hana는 11월 13일 18:00 KST까지 framework lease creation·terminal result·new-generation retry, Victor는 11월 14일 정오까지 admission queue·aging·metric, Arjun은 11월 14일 17:00까지 driver lease table·generation rejection·suspect transition을 담당합니다. Elena는 11월 15일 정오까지 isolated context reset과 8-context firmware validation을 맡고 Chloe는 fault injection·acceptance report를 맡습니다. 저는 manifest review process, class definition, architecture record를 담당합니다. 어떤 feature도 broker를 우회하거나 private timeout을 요청할 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Chloe Martin
turns.en: Acceptance has six gates. Leakage requires zero reservation remaining more than sixty seconds after both liveness signals disappear. Continuity allows no audible dropout above forty milliseconds and no camera frame gap above two frame periods during cooperative reclaim. Isolation requires zero checksum or sequence change in neighboring contexts during forced reset. Staleness requires every old-generation command to be rejected before firmware execution. Fairness requires the ninety-fifth-percentile grant delay below thirty milliseconds for continuous work and below 180 milliseconds for aged burst work. Efficiency limits added application-processor wakeups to two per minute per active lease and broker CPU to 0.3 percent. Missing telemetry fails the run rather than removing it.
turns.ko: 수락 gate는 여섯 개입니다. Leakage는 두 liveness signal이 사라진 뒤 60초 넘게 남는 reservation 0건입니다. Continuity는 cooperative reclaim 중 40ms 초과 audible dropout 0건, 두 frame period 초과 camera gap 0건입니다. Isolation은 forced reset 중 neighboring context checksum·sequence 변화 0건입니다. Staleness는 모든 old-generation command가 firmware 실행 전에 거부돼야 합니다. Fairness는 continuous work의 95백분위 grant delay 30ms 미만, aged burst work 180ms 미만입니다. Efficiency는 active lease당 application-processor wakeup 분당 2회, broker CPU 0.3%로 제한합니다. Telemetry 누락은 run에서 제외하지 않고 실패로 처리합니다.

turns.speaker: Arjun Patel
turns.en: The driver will expose an append-only event ring for grant, renewal, suspect, cooperative revoke, forced reclaim, generation reject, context reset, and firmware reset. Each record contains monotonic time, lease generation, anonymous class, capacity units, and reason code. The ring has a fixed 64-kilobyte budget and overwrites oldest records only after exporting a loss counter. Production reports aggregate counts; debug builds can retain the full ring. We will inject client death at every command boundary, delayed binder death, descriptor leaks, renewal jitter, and stale DMA submissions. A lease-table checksum failure disables new grants and falls back to CPU rather than reconstructing ownership from partial state.
turns.ko: Driver는 grant, renewal, suspect, cooperative revoke, forced reclaim, generation reject, context reset, firmware reset용 append-only event ring을 노출합니다. 각 record는 monotonic time, lease generation, anonymous class, capacity unit, reason code를 포함합니다. Ring은 64KB fixed budget이며 loss counter를 export한 뒤에만 oldest record를 덮습니다. Production은 aggregate count, debug build는 full ring을 유지할 수 있습니다. 모든 command boundary에서 client death, delayed binder death, descriptor leak, renewal jitter, stale DMA submission을 주입합니다. Lease-table checksum 실패 시 partial state에서 ownership을 재구축하지 않고 new grant를 끄고 CPU fallback합니다.

turns.speaker: Hana Lee
turns.en: Framework rollback has three independent controls. We can disable borrowing while retaining generation safety and fixed class reservations. We can disable same-session dormant promotion while retaining active leases. We can disable DSP admission entirely and use established CPU paths while preserving event collection. None of those controls permits old-generation buffers to return. Remote configuration may narrow class budgets or turn features off, but it cannot extend the sixty-second platform cap or suppress reason codes. I will add compatibility tests showing that an older framework treats an unknown terminal result as session loss and creates fresh buffers, while a newer framework handles an older driver without assuming lease enforcement exists.
turns.ko: Framework rollback은 독립 control 세 개입니다. Generation safety와 fixed class reservation을 유지하며 borrowing을 끌 수 있습니다. Active lease를 유지하며 same-session dormant promotion을 끌 수 있습니다. Event collection을 보존하며 DSP admission 전체를 끄고 기존 CPU path를 쓸 수 있습니다. 어떤 control도 old-generation buffer 복귀를 허용하지 않습니다. Remote configuration은 class budget을 줄이거나 feature를 끌 수 있지만 60초 platform cap을 늘리거나 reason code를 숨길 수 없습니다. Older framework가 unknown terminal result를 session loss로 처리하고 fresh buffer를 만들며 newer framework가 older driver에서 lease enforcement가 있다고 가정하지 않는 compatibility test를 추가합니다.

turns.speaker: Victor Ramos
turns.en: The pilot will run four workloads in pairs and triples: camera enhancement, spatial audio, transcription, and background photo indexing. We will execute 12,000 lifecycle cycles across low-memory kill, permission revocation, user switch, service restart, firmware delay, and normal pause. The matrix includes cool, warm, and charging thermal states because CPU fallback cost changes with headroom. For every cycle we retain grant timeline, liveness signals, generation transitions, output checksum, deadline misses, and fallback energy. The first dashboard is due November 16 at 11:00 KST. I will highlight distributions by class and conflict pattern, not only a global success percentage.
turns.ko: Pilot은 camera enhancement, spatial audio, transcription, background photo indexing 네 workload를 pair와 triple로 실행합니다. Low-memory kill, permission revocation, user switch, service restart, firmware delay, normal pause에 걸쳐 lifecycle cycle 12,000회를 수행합니다. CPU fallback cost가 headroom에 따라 바뀌므로 cool, warm, charging thermal state를 포함합니다. 매 cycle에서 grant timeline, liveness signal, generation transition, output checksum, deadline miss, fallback energy를 보존합니다. 첫 dashboard는 11월 16일 11:00 KST까지입니다. Global success percentage뿐 아니라 class·conflict pattern별 distribution을 강조합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Novak
turns.en: We will start with a shadow mode where the broker computes lease decisions but the driver does not enforce reclaim. Shadow mode lets us compare predicted expiry with actual workload continuity and tune false-suspect rates. It cannot validate stale-command rejection, so enforcement begins on internal devices after two days if false suspect stays below 0.2 percent. The rollout then moves from 1 percent to 10 percent and 30 percent, each with a forty-eight-hour hold. Any neighboring-context corruption, old-generation execution, or full DSP reset caused by ordinary expiry stops the pilot immediately. Slow reclamation pauses expansion but keeps shadow telemetry active.
turns.ko: 처음에는 broker가 lease decision을 계산하지만 driver가 reclaim을 enforce하지 않는 shadow mode를 사용합니다. Predicted expiry와 실제 workload continuity를 비교하고 false-suspect rate를 조정할 수 있습니다. Stale-command rejection은 검증하지 못하므로 false suspect가 0.2% 미만이면 이틀 뒤 internal device에서 enforcement를 시작합니다. Rollout은 1%, 10%, 30%로 이동하고 각 단계 48시간 hold합니다. Neighboring-context corruption, old-generation execution, ordinary expiry로 인한 full DSP reset이 하나라도 있으면 pilot을 즉시 중단합니다. Slow reclamation은 확장을 pause하지만 shadow telemetry는 유지합니다.

turns.speaker: Chloe Martin
turns.en: Quality will review every forced reclaim in the 1 percent stage, not a sample. We will classify it as correct stale-owner recovery, false reclaim, late reclaim, or insufficient evidence. A low overall error rate cannot hide a concentrated problem in continuous audio, so each platform class must pass independently. We also require a twelve-hour endurance run with repeated pause and resume to detect generation wrap, timer drift, and event-ring loss. Complete acceptance results are due November 18 at 14:00 KST. If isolated context reset is not proven, the pilot may still ship generation rejection and admission budgets with forced reclaim disabled; we will not substitute a full DSP reset.
turns.ko: Quality는 1% 단계의 forced reclaim을 sample이 아니라 전수 검토합니다. Correct stale-owner recovery, false reclaim, late reclaim, insufficient evidence로 분류합니다. 낮은 overall error rate가 continuous audio의 집중 문제를 숨기면 안 되므로 platform class별로 독립 통과해야 합니다. Generation wrap, timer drift, event-ring loss를 찾기 위해 반복 pause·resume 12시간 endurance run도 필요합니다. Complete acceptance result는 11월 18일 14:00 KST까지입니다. Isolated context reset이 증명되지 않아도 forced reclaim을 끈 채 generation rejection과 admission budget으로 pilot할 수 있으며 full DSP reset으로 대체하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Samir Gupta
turns.en: The decision is a bounded internal pilot, not production approval. Shadow integration may merge after peer review, while enforcement remains behind a production-off flag until all staleness, isolation, continuity, fairness, and efficiency gates pass. The acceptance meeting is November 18 at 16:30 KST with all six participants. If the lease model fails, we retain the event ring and admission metrics but return to CPU fallback on ambiguous ownership. If only borrowing fails, fixed class budgets remain. We will document every exception request and reject any request that lacks reproducible evidence. I will publish the architecture record, owner table, and stop conditions by 10:00 KST tomorrow. Our next design checkpoint is November 16 at 15:00 KST. The meeting is closed.
turns.ko: 결론은 제한된 internal pilot이지 production approval이 아닙니다. Shadow integration은 peer review 후 merge할 수 있지만 enforcement는 모든 staleness, isolation, continuity, fairness, efficiency gate 통과 전 production-off flag 뒤에 둡니다. Acceptance meeting은 11월 18일 16:30 KST이며 여섯 명 모두 참석합니다. Lease model이 실패하면 event ring과 admission metric은 유지하지만 ambiguous ownership에서 CPU fallback으로 돌아갑니다. Borrowing만 실패하면 fixed class budget은 유지합니다. 모든 exception request를 문서화하고 재현 가능한 증거가 없는 요청은 거부합니다. 내일 10:00 KST까지 architecture record, owner table, stop condition을 게시합니다. 다음 design checkpoint는 11월 16일 15:00 KST입니다. 회의를 마칩니다.
